_about: Rules you may change. One cheap check (MillionVerifier) costs about 1 credit.
_max_candidates: The most patterns tried per person. The 8 most common patterns find most addresses.
_deep_candidates: On a catch-all domain: how many candidates are saved for the catch-all-verifier.
_catch_all_after: This many 'catch_all' answers at one domain mark it catch-all, even if the test address said otherwise.
_approval_above: A run that can cost more credits than this waits for a person to approve it. The ask shows the most it can cost.
_workers: Company domains checked at the same time.
